register.labelZh: BOUNCE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: bounce back 可以描述一個人、球隊或商店在困難後恢復健康、信心或良好表現。；bounce back 可以清楚表示電郵未能送達收件者,因而被退回。；bounce somebody into something 可以表示某人在未有足夠時間考慮前,便被迫作出決定。；bounce ideas around 適合用來表示一群人在作決定前,一起討論不同可能性。
register.summaryEn: Bounce back helps you describe a person, team or business becoming well, confident or successful again. Bounce back can explain clearly that an email did not reach the intended person and was returned. Bounce somebody into something shows that a person was pushed into deciding before having enough time to think. Bounce ideas around is useful when a group wants to explore different possibilities before deciding.
